sql: SELECT TOP 20 p.SKU AS parentProductSku, fv.SKU AS variantSku, fv.ProductName AS variantName, fv.PimProductId AS variantProductId, fv.rn AS variantPosition, tx.sd AS shortDescription, tx.ld AS details, COALESCE(tx.sp, tx.psp) AS specifications, tx.sh AS shippingInfo, gp.price AS price, sw.val AS swatches, cf.ai AS additionalInfo, lnk.fb AS frequentlyBought, lnk.ym AS youMayAlsoLike, lnk.fbp AS frequentlyBoughtPrices, lnk.ymp AS youMayAlsoLikePrices, iv.lst AS inventoryList, iv.dn AS defaultWarehouseName, iv.dq AS defaultWarehouseQty, iv.aq AS allLocationsQty, iv.da AS defaultWarehouseAddress, iv.oa AS otherWarehouseAddresses, iv.dl AS defaultWarehouseLabel, iv.ol AS otherWarehouseLabels FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.StoreCode = @store INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeLocale loc ON loc.IsDefault = @defaultLocale LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalProfile anon ON anon.PortalId = po.PortalId AND anon.IsDefaultAnonymousProfile = @anonymousProfile CROSS APPLY (SELECT z.PimProductId, z.SKU, z.ProductName, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY z.SKU) AS rn FROM (SELECT v.PimProductId, v.SKU, v.ProductName FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation a INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct v ON v.PimProductId = a.PimProductId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory i ON i.SKU = v.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId WHERE a.PimParentProductId = p.PimProductId AND v.IsActive = @isActive AND pw.PortalId = po.PortalId GROUP BY v.PimProductId, v.SKU, v.ProductName HAVING SUM(i.Quantity) >= @quantityUsed) z OUTER APPLY (SELECT STRING_AGG(CONCAT(sp1.PimAttributeId, @pairSep, sd1.PimAttributeDefaultValueId), @listSep) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sp1.PimAttributeId) AS sig FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue sa1 INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute sp1 ON sp1.PimAttributeId = sa1.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeDefaultValue sd1 ON sd1.PimAttributeValueId = sa1.PimAttributeValueId WHERE sa1.PimProductId = z.PimProductId AND sp1.IsConfigurable = @isConfigurable AND sd1.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId AND EXISTS (SELECT sc1.PimConfigureProductAttributeId FROM dbo.ZnodePimConfigureProductAttribute sc1 WHERE sc1.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND sc1.PimAttributeId = sp1.PimAttributeId)) zs WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT a2.PimProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation a2 INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct v2 ON v2.PimProductId = a2.PimProductId CROSS APPLY (SELECT STRING_AGG(CONCAT(sp2.PimAttributeId, @pairSep, sd2.PimAttributeDefaultValueId), @listSep) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sp2.PimAttributeId) AS sig FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue sa2 INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute sp2 ON sp2.PimAttributeId = sa2.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeDefaultValue sd2 ON sd2.PimAttributeValueId = sa2.PimAttributeValueId WHERE sa2.PimProductId = v2.PimProductId AND sp2.IsConfigurable = @isConfigurable AND sd2.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId AND EXISTS (SELECT sc2.PimConfigureProductAttributeId FROM dbo.ZnodePimConfigureProductAttribute sc2 WHERE sc2.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND sc2.PimAttributeId = sp2.PimAttributeId)) s2 WHERE a2.PimParentProductId = p.PimProductId AND v2.PimProductId <> z.PimProductId AND v2.IsActive = @isActive AND s2.sig = zs.sig)) fv OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN x.r = @n1 AND x.c = @shortDescriptionCode THEN x.v END) AS sd, MAX(CASE WHEN x.r = @n1 AND x.c = @detailsCode THEN x.v END) AS ld, MAX(CASE WHEN x.r = @n1 AND x.c = @specificationsCode THEN x.v END) AS sp, MAX(CASE WHEN x.r = @n2 AND x.c = @specificationsCode THEN x.v END) AS psp, MAX(CASE WHEN x.r = @n1 AND x.c = @shippingInfoCode THEN x.v END) AS sh, MAX(CASE WHEN x.c = @uomCode THEN x.v END) AS um FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN av.PimProductId = fv.PimProductId THEN @n1 ELSE @n2 END AS r, pa.AttributeCode AS c, COALESCE(ta.AttributeValue, avl.AttributeValue, dl.AttributeDefaultValue) AS v FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue av INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute pa ON pa.PimAttributeId = av.PimAttributeId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeTextAreaValue ta ON ta.PimAttributeValueId = av.PimAttributeValueId AND ta.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValueLocale avl ON avl.PimAttributeValueId = av.PimAttributeValueId AND avl.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeDefaultValue dd ON dd.PimAttributeValueId = av.PimAttributeValueId AND dd.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeDefaultValueLocale dl ON dl.PimAttributeDefaultValueId = dd.PimAttributeDefaultValueId AND dl.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId WHERE av.PimProductId IN (fv.PimProductId, p.PimProductId)) x) tx OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 pl.PriceListId, COALESCE(pr.SalesPrice, pr.RetailPrice) AS price FROM dbo.ZnodePriceList pl INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePrice pr ON pr.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListProfile plf ON plf.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId AND plf.PortalProfileId = anon.PortalProfileID LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal plo ON plo.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId AND plo.PortalId = po.PortalId WHERE pr.SKU = fv.SKU AND (plf.PriceListProfileId IS NOT NULL OR plo.PriceListPortalId IS NOT NULL) AND (pl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (pr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pr.ExpirationDate >= @now) ORDER BY CASE WHEN plf.PriceListProfileId IS NOT NULL THEN @n1 ELSE @n2 END, plf.Precedence, plo.Precedence, pl.PriceListId) gp OUTER APPLY (SELECT STRING_AGG(atl.AttributeName + @pairSep + dvl.AttributeDefaultValue, @listSep) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pa.DisplayOrder, pa.AttributeCode) AS val FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue av INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute pa ON pa.PimAttributeId = av.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeLocale atl ON atl.PimAttributeId = pa.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeDefaultValue pdv ON pdv.PimAttributeValueId = av.PimAttributeValueId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeDefaultValueLocale dvl ON dvl.PimAttributeDefaultValueId = pdv.PimAttributeDefaultValueId WHERE av.PimProductId = fv.PimProductId AND pa.IsConfigurable = @isConfigurable AND EXISTS (SELECT cpa.PimConfigureProductAttributeId FROM dbo.ZnodePimConfigureProductAttribute cpa WHERE cpa.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND cpa.PimAttributeId = pa.PimAttributeId) AND atl.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId AND dvl.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId AND pdv.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId) sw OUTER APPLY (SELECT STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN la.AttributeCode = @frequentlyBoughtCode THEN lp.SKU + @skuNameSep + lp.ProductName END, @listSep) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lk.DisplayOrder, lp.SKU) AS fb, STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN la.AttributeCode = @youMayAlsoLikeCode THEN lp.SKU + @skuNameSep + lp.ProductName END, @listSep) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lk.DisplayOrder, lp.SKU) AS ym, STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN la.AttributeCode = @frequentlyBoughtCode THEN CONCAT(lp.SKU, @skuNameSep, lpp.price) END, @listSep) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lk.DisplayOrder, lp.SKU) AS fbp, STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN la.AttributeCode = @youMayAlsoLikeCode THEN CONCAT(lp.SKU, @skuNameSep, lpp.price) END, @listSep) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY lk.DisplayOrder, lp.SKU) AS ymp FROM dbo.ZnodePimLinkProductDetail lk INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute la ON la.PimAttributeId = lk.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct lp ON lp.PimProductId = lk.PimProductId OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 xr.RetailPrice AS price FROM dbo.ZnodePriceList xl INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePrice xr ON xr.PriceListId = xl.PriceListId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListProfile xf ON xf.PriceListId = xl.PriceListId AND xf.PortalProfileId = anon.PortalProfileID LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal xo ON xo.PriceListId = xl.PriceListId AND xo.PortalId = po.PortalId WHERE xr.SKU = lp.SKU AND (xf.PriceListProfileId IS NOT NULL OR xo.PriceListPortalId IS NOT NULL) AND (xl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR xl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (xl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR xl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (xr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR xr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (xr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR xr.ExpirationDate >= @now) ORDER BY CASE WHEN xf.PriceListProfileId IS NOT NULL THEN @n1 ELSE @n2 END, xf.Precedence, xo.Precedence, xl.PriceListId) lpp WHERE lk.PimParentProductId = p.PimProductId AND lp.IsActive = @isActive) lnk OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 x.ai FROM (SELECT f.PimProductId, STRING_AGG(fl.CustomKey + @keyValueSep + fl.CustomKeyValue, @listSep) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f.DisplayOrder, f.CustomCode) AS ai FROM dbo.ZnodePimCustomField f INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCustomFieldLocale fl ON fl.PimCustomFieldId = f.PimCustomFieldId AND fl.LocaleId = loc.LocaleId WHERE f.PimProductId IN (fv.PimProductId, p.PimProductId) GROUP BY f.PimProductId) x ORDER BY CASE WHEN x.PimProductId = fv.PimProductId THEN @n1 ELSE @n2 END) cf OUTER APPLY (SELECT STRING_AGG(CONCAT(w.wn, @pairSep, w.q), @listSep) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY w.r, w.pr, w.wid) AS lst, MAX(CASE WHEN w.r = @n1 THEN w.wn END) AS dn, SUM(CASE WHEN w.r = @n1 THEN w.q END) AS dq, SUM(w.q) AS aq, MAX(CASE WHEN w.r = @n1 THEN COALESCE(w.wa, TRIM(@space)) END) AS da, STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN w.r = @n2 THEN COALESCE(w.wa, TRIM(@space)) END, @listSep) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY w.r, w.pr, w.wid) AS oa, MAX(CASE WHEN w.r = @n1 THEN w.wl END) AS dl, STRING_AGG(CASE WHEN w.r = @n2 THEN w.wl END, @listSep) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY w.r, w.pr, w.wid) AS ol FROM (SELECT ws.r, ws.pr, ws.wid, wh.WarehouseName AS wn, CAST(i.Quantity AS bigint) AS q, wad.t AS wa, lb.l AS wl FROM (SELECT @n1 AS r, pw.Precedence AS pr, pw.WarehouseId AS wid FROM dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw WHERE pw.PortalId = po.PortalId UNION ALL SELECT @n2 AS r, aw.Precedence AS pr, aw.WarehouseId AS wid FROM dbo.ZnodePortalAlternateWarehouse aw INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse apw ON apw.PortalWarehouseId = aw.PortalWarehouseId WHERE apw.PortalId = po.PortalId) ws INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeWarehouse wh ON wh.WarehouseId = ws.wid INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory i ON i.WarehouseId = ws.wid AND i.SKU = fv.SKU OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 CONCAT_WS(@space, CASE WHEN LEN(za.Address1) > @zero THEN TRIM(za.Address1) END, CASE WHEN LEN(za.Address2) > @zero THEN TRIM(za.Address2) END, CASE WHEN LEN(za.StateName) > @zero THEN TRIM(za.StateName) END) AS t, CONCAT_WS(@space, CASE WHEN LEN(za.CityName) > @zero THEN TRIM(za.CityName) END, CASE WHEN LEN(za.PostalCode) > @zero THEN TRIM(za.PostalCode) END) AS c FROM dbo.ZnodeWarehouseAddress wa INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeAddress za ON za.AddressId = wa.AddressId WHERE wa.WarehouseId = wh.WarehouseId ORDER BY wa.WarehouseAddressId) wad CROSS APPLY (SELECT TRIM(CONCAT_WS(@space, CASE WHEN LEN(wh.WarehouseName) > @zero THEN TRIM(wh.WarehouseName) END, wad.c)) AS l) lb) w) iv WHERE p.SKU = @parentSku AND p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState ORDER BY fv.rn
